title: Masters and platform settings
summary: Add or remove masters, reset a lost phone's two-step sign-in, and change platform-wide settings.

items: Open the **Masters** tab and choose **Add master**.
Copy the **temporary password** and send it to them privately. It is shown once.
They sign in with Store ID **PLATFORM**, then choose their own password.
**Remove** turns a master off and signs them out everywhere. You can't remove yourself or the last master.
**Reset two-step** is for a lost phone: their two-step sign-in is turned off and they set it up again at their next sign-in.
To move your own two-step sign-in to a new phone, enter a code from your current phone first.

blocks.text: The **Platform settings** tab changes settings for the whole platform. A change works straight away, with no restart, and is recorded in Audit with the old and new value. **Reset** goes back to the server's own value.

items: **New store sign-ups**: off closes the public sign-up page. Existing stores are not affected.
**Terms page link** and **Support email** are shown to store owners.
**Plan for new stores**, **Days before an archived store's data is deleted** and **Hours a download link works**.

blocks.text: Security switches (two-step sign-in for masters, dedicated hosting, keys and database addresses) are set on the server, never in the console.
